# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_BEAR_ENTRY_ADJUST_20260907

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The base strategy loses on 4/29 and 5/01 J winner days because it incorrectly avoids bearish entries when VIX is between 15-20, missing profitable put setups. The current VIX confirmation rule for bearish entries (VIX rising OR above 20) is too strict, filtering out valid bearish opportunities during moderate fear regimes. Lowering the VIX threshold to 15 will capture more bearish winners while maintaining skip discipline on loser days.

## Mechanism

Change the VIX confirmation filter for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (PUTS) from `VIX >= 20 OR rising` to `VIX >= 15 OR rising`. This allows bearish entries when VIX is at least 15 (moderate fear) rather than requiring elevated fear (VIX>=20). All other context filters (time, structure, ribbon spread, volume divergence) remain unchanged. Exit logic (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +100%) stays identical.
